_about: Palette unlock conditions, same shape as design/tokens/palettes.json but with the thresholds approved after the milestone 2 bot runs (the tokens still hold the old placeholders). The game reads unlocks from here; colors still come from the tokens. beat_rival means a run scoring above that rival's score in rivals.json. null = always unlocked (Signal, the default, and Plaintext, the colorblind-safe palette). Only Arcade runs count toward unlocks.
